sources.name: W3C Internationalization: Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm basics

provenance.notes: Written in this phase from the cited references and re-expressed; the Arabic text is the researcher's own wording and needs a native reviewer. The checks are proposals for the harness, not yet run.

statement.ar: ترتيب العناصر في DOM هو الترتيب المنطقي للقراءة في الاتجاهين. لا تُنشئ مظهر RTL بعكس ترتيب العناصر (row-reverse، order، float) ولا بكتابة النص معكوسًا أو بترتيب بصري.
statement.en: The order of elements in the DOM is the logical reading order in both directions. Do not create an RTL appearance by reversing element order (row-reverse, order, float) or by writing text reversed or in visual order.

rationale.ar: قارئ الشاشة ومفتاح Tab يتبعان المصدر. التخطيط المعكوس بصريًا يجعل التنقل يسير من النهاية إلى البداية.
rationale.en: Screen readers and the Tab key follow the source. A visually reversed layout makes navigation run from the end to the start.

checks: The sequence of focusable elements in DOM order equals their visual order along the inline axis from start to end, in both directions.
No style uses flex-direction: row-reverse or order to produce the RTL layout.
No text node contains Arabic stored in visual order (presentation forms U+FE70–U+FEFF outside test data).
